description: Crop calibration config for Pokemon TCG Pocket binder screenshots (iPhone 15 Pro, 1179x2556 px). Edit per_screenshot_overrides to fix individual misaligned screenshots without reprocessing the full batch. See crop_override_workflow.md for the full procedure.

notes.left_x: x-pixel where the left edge of column 1 begins
notes.top_y: y-pixel where the top of row 1 card content begins
notes.card_width: width of one card tile column in pixels
notes.card_height_tile: height of card tile content only, excluding separator
notes.row_gap: height of the binder separator strip between tile rows
notes.card_height_cell: step between row y-origins = card_height_tile + row_gap; if you set card_height_tile and row_gap, card_height_cell is recomputed automatically
